title: Fast Structured Logging with pino
description: Runnable pino logging examples: shared logger config with redaction and serializers, Express app with pino-http request logging and request ids, and Fastify app with built-in pino. Correct logger.info(obj, msg) ordering throughout.
description_es: Ejemplos ejecutables de logging con pino: config compartida con redacción y serializers, app Express con pino-http y request ids, y app Fastify con pino integrado. Orden correcto logger.info(obj, msg) en todo el código.
